headline: Sri Lankan Shares Lower as Financial Stocks Drag Market
summary: The CSE All-Share index in Sri Lanka closed 0.14% lower at 21,701.07 points, pulled down by drops in Commercial Bank of Ceylon and Carson Cumberbatch.
why: The Colombo Stock Exchange is Sri Lanka's primary stock market platform.

impacts.name: CSE All-Share Index
impacts.why: Sri Lankan equities edged down led by local banking constituents.
